generated_assets.role: Uncompressed intermediate; the first 1024 sorted rows form the Live bank
Live uncompressed bank; TaylorF2 is selected by the Live command

generation.hash_policy: Every generated file must match its recorded SHA-256 and size; changed HDF5 serialization or numerical output is a different input, never silently accepted
generation.historical_verification: The 2026-10-08 regeneration receipt records exact original XML, subset, source rows and compressed bank hashes. The preparation CLI is a recovered recipe, not a new full-generation measurement.
generation.scope: Uncompressed 1024-template Live subset; this historical PyCBC revision is an input-generation binding, not the measured baseline.

selection.algorithm: NumPy default_rng(seed).permutation(eligible rows), first 1536 distinct physical tuples, then sort selected source row IDs
selection.cuts: mass1 <= 10, mass2 <= 3, chirp mass >= 1.2, abs(spin1z) <= 0.2, abs(spin2z) <= 0.2
selection.live_subset: First 1024 rows of that sorted 1536-row subset

public_assets.provenance: O2 bank distributed by gwastro/pycbc-config at commit 710dbfd3590bd93d7679d7822da59fcb6b6fac0f
public_assets.redistribution: Not rehosted here; no explicit license established for this input

public_url_verification.method: Streamed every public URL through SHA-256; all three sizes and hashes matched the recorded campaign inputs
